message: 本当の宣戦布告

name: Synn
message: 「Welcome back, Misa. Is patrol going smoothly?」

name: Misa
message: 「No issues to report. Naturally.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you on break too, by any chance, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「I am, yes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, what a coincidence. Actually, so am I.」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, is that so?」

name: Synn
message: 「Since we're both free--」

name: Misa
message: 「I refuse!!」
I hadn't even said anything yet...

name: Misa
message: 「I can't possibly let you see my hobbies. Especially not you, Sakura-kun!」

name: Misa
message: 「Now then, enjoy your break.」
With that, Misa walked off somewhere.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Too bad!! If you spent your break with Nanaka-chan instead, you'd have a super fun time♪」

name: Synn
message: 「If I hang out with you, Nanaka, you'll just mooch off me~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like you even have anything to mooch!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmph... That's not true, I'm the Student Council President, after all!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah, I get it, so hurry up and go on your break already.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm off~」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder where Eddie is.」
Finding a friend in this crowd is a real chore. Is this the kind of situation where a cell phone comes in handy?

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, Misa...?」
At the used book market, there was Misa, absorbed not in standing and browsing, but sitting and reading.

name: Misa
message: 「Aah... How terribly romantic. It touches the very depths of my heart...」

name: Misa
message: 「Reading a wonderful book truly stirs the imagination. Oh, a lovely poem just came to me\s04」
Holding a book dearly against her chest, she lost herself in thought.

name: Paqy
message: 「Shoplifting is a crime, ya know」

name: Misa
message: 「As if I would ever do something like that!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Find anything good?」

name: Misa
message: 「S-S-Sakura-kuuun!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, sorry. Didn't mean to startle you. Whatcha looking at?」

name: Misa
message: 「I believe I told you we wouldn't be shopping together! And yet, why--」

name: Synn
message: 「I literally just happened to be passing by, though...」

name: Misa
message: 「Ha! Could it be that you were following me?」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So that's how it was--」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm the one asking!!」

name: Synn
message: 「You've got the wrong idea. I was looking for my friends, but I just can't seem to find them」

name: Misa
message: 「So you're all alone?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yep. Unfortunately」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph. You really aren't popular, are you? Even though you're the Student Council President」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're one to talk, Hiss--you don't have anyone with ya either」

name: Misa
message: 「I simply wanted to go shopping by myself!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Bet ya were planning to buy some shady goods you can't show anyone」

name: Misa
message: 「Whatever could you mean? As the Vice President, I don't have a single thing to feel guilty about」

name: Synn
message: 「Then you won't mind telling me what you were reading, right!」

name: Misa
message: 「~~~Tch! W-What I was reading was... yes, pure literature!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh-ho~~」

name: Misa
message: 「You ought to try reading some yourself. It would surely cleanse that blackened heart of yours」

name: Synn
message: 「Hear that, Paqy?」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm talking to you, Sakura-kun!!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So that's how it was--」
Do I really look like my heart has grown cold and bitter......?

name: Synn
message: 「So, what do you recommend?」

name: Misa
message: 「It's probably just lying around over there somewhere.」
How half-hearted. I pick up the book Misa is pointing at.

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Th-This is......!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Calm down and read it.」

name: Synn
message: 「This is indecent, Misa!! Th-Th-This kind of thing...」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's more, the character's position is Student Council President, just like Master Synn......」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't want to hear it, but...... what on earth is that supposed to imply?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「It means Hisu is hoping for a development just like this......!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So that's how it was!!」
The Student Council President gets pounced on by a headstrong boy-the Vice President-and...... ah, I simply cannot say any more!\s03

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, Sakura-kun. What have you been babbling about this whole time?」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be...... you became Vice President in order to make the contents of this book a reality......」

name: Misa
message: 「I only ended up in the vice position because of you!! Forget it, just let me see that book.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ba-dump, ba-dump......」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaa!! Isn't this a Boys' Love novel!?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's way too indecent, Misa!! Reading a book about boys getting all lovey-dovey with each other!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-This is completely wrong!! It's totally backwards!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Impressive as always, Hisu. The author of this doesn't know a damn thing.」

name: Paqy
message: 「With this pairing, the one who looks like Master Synn should be the top. To catch a mistake like that...... you really know your stuff, Hisu.」

name: Misa
message: 「No, no, that's not it!! That's not what I meant--what I was reading is......!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then what were you reading?」

name: Misa
message: 「Nnnnnngh!」
She held out the book she had been clutching to her chest.

name: Synn
message: 「'Triangle on the G String ~Sisters' Rondo~'......?」
Flipping casually through the pages, I spotted illustrations of a cute girl interspersed throughout.
Blushing, her gaze was fixed on a slender, handsome young man lost in twilight melancholy.
Apparently, that guy was interested in a different, older woman, and that woman had taken a liking to the first girl.

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is this a love story?」

name: Misa
message: 「It's a girls' novel!! Even this counts as bona fide literature!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. You like reading novels, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「What's it to you... If you've got a complaint, let's hear it.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, not at all. I think it really suits you, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Nnnngh!! Stop making fun of me!! You...」

name: Misa
message: 「I hate you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Did I do something wrong?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not knowing what you did is the exact reason you get hated.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So that's it! Still, she didn't say she *really* hates me, so I can totally bounce back!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Bounce back from what...?」
I wandered around wherever my feet took me.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Ponpoko is selling plushies.」
Mixed in among the crowd of kids were several schoolgirls.

name: Synn
message: 「They sure love plushies~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just proves they're a bunch of brats.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I know.」
I sneaked Paqy onto the display right next to the plushies on sale.

name: Synn
message: 「Yep. Blends right in!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, knock it off!」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse me, excuse me! Please sell me this Blackuma! Right now! I'll pay whatever money I have!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa...?」

name: Misa
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Misa
message: 「--So that means it's not Blackuma, it's Paqy-san?」

name: Paqy
message: 「The great me belongs to Ria-chan!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, sorry. I didn't think you'd jump right at him」

name: Misa
message: 「You're so misleading!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Engaging in human trafficking already, just as expected of Synn-sama」

name: Synn
message: 「Pandas are protected natural monuments, so that's impossible」

name: Paqy
message: 「Protected natural monument, you bastard!! Make a fool out of me and I won't forgive you!?」
It's only at times like this that he demands to be treated like a human.

name: Misa
message: 「Trying to sell Paqy-san, you inhuman monster!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hihi, inhuman monster!?」
Come to think of it, we were demons after all.

name: Synn
message: 「--I mean, no! Look who's talking, Misa, you were trying to buy Paqy yourself...」

name: Misa
message: 「That was... well...」

name: Misa
message: 「I was just trying to save Paqy-san!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Not Blackuma?」

name: Misa
message: 「Drop it already! In the first place, if Sakura-kun hadn't pulled that stupid prank, none of this would've happened!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, that is completely true. Sorry」

name: Misa
message: 「As long as you get it, fine. See ya」

name: Synn
message: 「To make up for it, I'll look for a Blackuma plushie too!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh. Y-You don't have to do that. It's not like I particularly want one or anything」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if Ponpoko doesn't have it, another shop might. It's still too early to give up」

name: Misa
message: 「I told you, you don't need to look for it!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Sacchin. Did any of the classes happen to be selling Blackuma?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Blackuma? Ahh, I might've seen one over at the basketball club's stall earlier~」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Listen when someone's talking to you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go together」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah... y-yeah」

name: Misa
message: 「It was just like a scene straight out of a novel」

name: Misa
message: 「His sudden, gentle, and tender words echoed over and over in my head and heart」

name: Misa
message: 「Let's go. Let's go. Let's go together」

name: Misa
message: 「Drawn in, pulled toward him」

name: Misa
message: 「So much so that I nearly reached out to touch his proffered hand without thinking」

name: Misa
message: 「His smile looked dazzling to me」

name: Synn
message: 「That's too bad」

name: Misa
message: 「Time's up, after all. We don't have much choice but to give up, do we」
Break time was nearly over, and we ended up unable to find Blackuma after all.

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, you played me like a fiddle. Getting dragged along just to kill your boredom」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「You're always joking around, so when you suddenly put on a serious face like that, of course it catches me off guard...」

name: Synn
message: 「I just wondered if you'd be able to tell the difference, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「What's that supposed to mean? I really don't like how you talk like you're the only one in the know」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, it is!! You're always like that. Always talking as if you can see right through me」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not...」
I'm always left feeling frustrated because I have no idea what Misa is thinking.

name: Misa
message: 「Even though I... don't know anything about you at all, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「About me...」
However, it seemed the same was true for Misa.

name: Misa
message: 「That's right!! I get it now. I was so afraid of everyone getting the wrong idea that I kept avoiding you」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so?」

name: Misa
message: 「But that's just proof that I'm running away from you, isn't it? That's why they take advantage of my weakness!」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't recall taking advantage of anything, though...」

name: Misa
message: 「I... want to know more about you, Sakura-kun」

name: Misa
message: 「If you know the enemy and know yourself, you need not fear the result of a hundred battles!!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So that's why--」

name: Misa
message: 「I've made up my mind. After this, I'll continue doing security patrols together with you.」
Things have gotten kind of complicated, though does this mean we'll be spending more time together than before?
Enrolling in this academy.
Having challenges thrown at me every time there was a test.
Even during the Student Council election, her hostility was off the charts.
Snapping at me during Student Council activities, too.
Even so, we somehow managed to pull it off.
And now, here we are, right in the middle of the fun, lively festival we built together.
After everything we went through, Misa and I are standing right in the heart of it.

name: Misa
message: 「Let's go」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa...」

name: Misa
message: 「Let's go together」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah!」
Overwhelmed by Misa's sudden boldness, I instinctively grabbed and held onto the hand she offered.

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaa!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-Whaaat!?」

name: Misa
message: 「A-Ah, I'm sorry. I just didn't expect you to actually touch me...」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I'm the one who should apologize!! I just couldn't help myself...」

name: Misa
message: 「Haa... I lost again...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph... For someone so slender, Sakura-kun, your palms really are like a proper boy's, aren't they」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What do you mean by that?」

name: Misa
message: 「Father always said that people who work hard get thick skin on their hands」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, really~」
Is this supposed to be a compliment? Feeling embarrassed, I decide to fire back.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, your hands, Misa... are so soft and smooth, and really pretty」

name: Misa
message: 「What's that supposed to mean!? Are you trying to say I don't work hard!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaat!? I just thought you take really good care of them, and how girly you are!!」

name: Misa
message: 「~~~! Making fun of me like that again!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not, I'm not!! Wait, what do you mean 'again'!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Fine, I'll teach you the truth. Come on, it's time for patrol!!」
It looked like my time alone with Misa was going to continue for quite a while longer.
